notes.title: Demo version v0.05.02 update
notes.notes:
1. The early process has been redesigned. Because of the big changes, the old version archive is no longer available.
2. Added fragmentation ability, which can be obtained during the process, replacing the original shield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266820/8898b230862cd4bc6050c34fd8b14c72d949e2cd.png

3. Now the gamepad type (PS4, PS5, Xbox, NS Pro) can be automatically identified.
4. The player character's fall damage is reduced, and the fall animation effect is optimized.
5. Removed the animation of sprint exhaustion.
6. Added automatic camera tracking (gamepad), which can be turned on in the control settings page.
7. Now no gold coins are dropped when you die.
8. The various areas of the game holographic map are distinguished by color.

notes.title: Demo version bug fixes
notes.notes:
1. The default key position has been adjusted, and rolling and sprinting have been split into two keys. In order to avoid key position conflicts, the configuration of player-defined keys has been reset.
2. Some known BUGs have been fixed.
